notes.title: Gamescom 2025: REANIMAL Delivers A Horrific Nightmare That I Can’t Wait To Play
notes.notes:
REANIMAL is one of the strangest games I have ever played. Even as I sit here reflecting on everything I experienced at gamescom 2025, it is the one I cannot get out of my mind. Developed by Tarsier Studios, the team behind Little Nightmares and Little Nightmares II, REANIMAL tells the story of two orphans exploring a “hellish island” in search of safety. But with this being a horror game, survival is never that simple. They quickly learn there are many dangers waiting to harm them, and only their wits can keep them alive.

On the surface, it may sound similar to Tarsier’s previous work, but there is something deeply unsettling about REANIMAL. The studio has managed to inject unease into almost every scene. I did not expect this level of tension when I sat down for my gameplay demo at a behind-closed-doors session, but within minutes of picking up the controller alongside another member of the press, it was clear REANIMAL is something special.

notes.title: Two Legends, One Secret: THQ Nordic (Almost) Unveils Its Gamescom 2025 Lineup
notes.notes:
Yep, we’re heading to Cologne again! THQ Nordic is thrilled to welcome you to gamescom 2025, where we’ll be showcasing three of our finest games. While one title must remain hidden like a treasure chest for now, the other two are well-known and highly anticipated.

Are you ready for the Gothic 1 Remake? Visit our booth in Hall 7 and immerse yourself in this legendary German RPG, now reborn in stunning Unreal Engine 5.
Check out the latest trailer: https://youtu.be/cRp9XeVk_0Q

Are you tough and not easily scared? Prove it by checking out Tarsier Studios’ brand-new horror game, REANIMAL, in Cologne. If you’ve got the guts, watch the latest trailer: https://youtu.be/bSAyHAzqQxk

As mentioned, we’ve got one more secret title waiting for players in Cologne. We can’t reveal anything yet, but we promise it’ll be worth the wait and a lot of fun! Stay tuned for the big announcement during the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase on August 1, 2025, live at 12:00 pm (PDT), 3:00 pm (EDT), 21:00 (CEST), and 22:00 (MSK). 

Check out the THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2025 website: https://showcase.thqnordic.com/

[b]THQ Nordic's playable games at gamescom 2025, Hall 7.1, Booth A11/B10
- Gothic Remake
- REANIMAL
- The Secret Game™[/b]

THQ Nordic's gamescom lineup will be streamed
Can’t make it to Cologne? We’ve got you covered. THQ Nordic is partnering with well-known content creators and international press outlets to stream live from our booth directly to your screens. Expect in-depth interviews with our developers and your favorite creators streaming our games. As gamescom approaches, we’ll share more details about participating channels and outlets.

[b]Tarsier Studios, the visionary creators behind Little Nightmares I & II have returned to unleash a new vision of horror in their game REANIMAL[/b]
 
Vienna, Austria - August 20, 2024: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In REANIMAL, a horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

Watch the Opening Night Live announcement trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=ai6lH55Dn8I;full][/previewyoutube]

REANIMAL is being developed by Tarsier Studios and published by THQ Nordic and will be available for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
